dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular ovoid and 'C' shaped light-gray rings are distributed across the mid-lateral flank, featuring high-contrast gradients from the dark base pelt to light-pixel perimeters with jagged, non-uniform edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate spatial density of solid, high-intensity light-gray clusters lacking internal gradients, concentrated primarily in the upper-dorsal and posterior-lateral regions interspersed between larger annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent mid-body annuli form an elongated quadrilateral, while smaller posterior blobs maintain a linear-oblique orientation relative to the longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: A sequence of approximately 6-8 parallel, high-contrast vertical light-toned striations is visible on the anterior-lateral region near the neck junction.
